title: Bourbon Slush
description: This bourbon slush recipe is a frozen blend of pineapple and orange juice, lemonade concentrate, tea, sugar, and whiskey, topped with lemon-lime soda.
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
1 (2 liter) bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage

steps.text: Stir pineapple juice, black tea, bourbon, sugar, lemonade concentrate, and orange juice concentrate together in a large bowl or container. Pour into shallow bowls or dishes. Freeze 8 hours to overnight.
Set slushies aside at room temperature for about 10 minutes; chop with a wire whisk or potato masher for a slushy consistency. Scoop into glasses; top with lemon-lime soda.
